intrastate_war.note: the engine writes intrastate = 1 and never 2 (intrastate_onset has no intensity), so the only mass here is a level-2 spell carried in from the as-of state and running until its termination hazard fires: this row is the cost of the missing intensity, not a forecast of it.

occupied.note: occupation is data in this model, not a hazard (docs/system.md): the engine carries the as-of value and never changes it, so this row scores a frozen number.
